atoms.text: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben to come, to give, to make und to see kennen.
atoms.sound: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to come. to give. to make</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to see</voice> kennen.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to come in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to come</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: They came to England 20 years ago.
My mum has just come home from work.
atoms.b: My mum has just ((come)) home from work.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to give in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to give</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: My aunt always gives me nice presents for my birthdays.
atoms.b: My aunt always ((gives)) me nice presents for my birthdays.

atoms.sound: Last year she gave me a book about Africa.
atoms.b: Last year she ((gave)) me a book about Africa.

atoms.sound: She has never given me boring books.
atoms.b: She has never ((given)) me boring books.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to make in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to make</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Every Sunday we make pancakes for breakfast.
atoms.b: Every Sunday we ((make)) pancakes for breakfast.

atoms.sound: Last Sunday we made them with chocolate chips.
atoms.b: Last Sunday we ((made)) them with chocolate chips.

atoms.sound: We've never made bacon and eggs.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to see in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to see</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I sometimes see beautiful birds in my city.
atoms.b: I sometimes ((see)) beautiful birds in my city.

atoms.sound: Last week I saw a parrot in the park.
atoms.b: Last week I ((saw)) a parrot in the park.

atoms.sound: My brother has already seen lots of parrots there.
atoms.b: My brother has already ((seen)) lots of parrots there.
